events.title: ECMA publishes Office Open XML standard
events.summary: ECMA International published the Office Open [XML] (OOXML) standard on December 7, 2006 — formalizing Microsoft Office 2007 document formats.
events.about: OOXML (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) became the default interchange format for office documents — parsers in Google Docs, LibreOffice, and countless ETL pipelines read ZIP-based [XML] packages defined here.

narrative.whyChosen: OOXML standardized the document formats behind modern office interoperability.
narrative.whyImportant: It enabled third-party tools to read and write Office files without reverse engineering.
narrative.problemSolved: Binary .doc files were opaque; vendors needed an open specification for documents.
